detail.longDescription: Learning French? KiosKe.fr aggregates independent, free media and LGBTQIA+ voices from French-speaking sources, so you can practise reading real news and real conversations, all in one place. No ads, no tracking, and everything is open source and self-hosted. ▎ ▎ https:// kioske.fr ▎ ▎ # LGBT # transgender # free # opensource
